text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from a training<n>session at a track
in the city...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf comes to a halt in front<n>of a display
window.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have been sleepwalking into<n>disaster, it seems...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The fruits of my indolence are<n>beginning to show. I
have put on<n>weight.
choice_data_list: You look the same to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. Can't you see<n>how the seams
of my skirt strain?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It appears the student council's<n>clerical duties have
done me no<n>favors...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I must set an example for myfellow students in both action andappearance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must redress this as quickly as<n>possible, and I am
afraid you will<n>have to assist me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, we work together on a diet<n>program until
Symboli Rudolf regains<n>a racing physique she is
satisfied<n>with.
